REKHA RAWAT 9960641281 Email Id:rekhaarrawat91@gmail.com rekha.rawat146653@gmail.com www.linkedin.com/in/rekha-rawat- 007416174

CORE COMPETENCIES Business Analysis Planning and Monitoring. Elicitation and Collaboration. Requirement Life cycle Management. Requirement Analysis and Design Definition. Strategy Analysis Solution Evaluation Stakeholder management Project management

DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE AML KYC,CDD,EDD Payments SAS,LexisNexis,KYCR Finacle,Flexcube, Swift, Sepa, ISO 20022

TECHNICAL SKILLS Project Management tool:- JIRA Database: SQL Reporting Tools: Power BI,Tableau Prototyping Wire frames Tools:Axure,Balsamiq

EDUCATION B.Sc. – St. Xavier’s (2012)

CERTIFICATIONS Certified – IT Business Analyst IIBA (2026) IFBI – PGDBF (2012)

LANGUAGES English Hindi Marathi

CAREER OBJECTIVE Business Analyst with 12 years of overall BFSI experience and 7+years of relevant BA experience in AML, KYC, and Payments. Strong expertise in requirements elicitation, BRD, FRD, user Stories, RTM, and Agile/Waterfall methodologies. Proven experience in UAT coordination, defect management, and stakeholder collaboration to deliver compliant, business-aligned solutions. Backed by deep banking operations and compliance knowledge with a strong analytical and process-driven approach.

PROFILE SUMMARY • • Proficient in Waterfall Model with BRD, FRD, SRS, RACI Matrix,

In-depth knowledge of SDLC in Waterfall and Agile.

UML Diagrams, Prototypes, RTM, and UAT Handling.

Expert in Agile Scrum with User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, BV, CP, Sprint Backlogs, DoR and DoD.

Strong banking operations, payments processing, and customer onboarding experience.

Deep exposure to AML, KYC, fraud monitoring, EDD, and compliance Reporting.

PROJECTS TCS | Business Process Lead | Feb 2023 – Feb 2026 Role: Business Analyst Project: TM Monitoring Enhancements – MUFG Bank (US) | Agile Project Description: Enhanced AML Transaction Monitoring by optimizing alerts and compliance screening for effective suspicious activity detection. • Gathered and validated business requirements; created user

stories, acceptance criteria, and managed the product backlog in JIRA.

Prioritized requirements using MoSCoW and FURPS; collaborated on BV, CP, DoR, and DoD for Agile sprint planning.

Participated in Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, and Retrospectives to ensure successful Agile delivery.

Supported PEP, Sanctions, and Adverse Media integrations, alert risk scoring, and threshold tuning for improved AML monitoring.

Trained and supervised a team of 8 QC analysts and managed complex alert reviews and QC escalations.

ARTIFACTS BRD, FRD, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, RTM (Requirements Traceability Matrix), UML Diagrams, Process Flow Diagrams, Wireframes / Mockups, Use Cases, Stakeholder Coordination, RACI Matrix.

Project: AML Case Management & QC Process Optimizations – MUFG Bank (US) | Agile Role: Business Analyst Project Description: Optimized AML case management and QC processes to improve investigation efficiency and regulatory compliance. • Gathered and documented business requirements; created user stories with acceptance criteria for AML case

management and QC workflows.

Prioritized requirements using MoSCoW and managed the sprint backlog in JIRA with the Product Owner and Scrum Master.

Validated the end-to-end AML case lifecycle during UAT, ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal AML policies.

Supported QC case allocation and workload management to improve review efficiency and SLA adherence. • Provided quality feedback, resolved process gaps, and improved investigation accuracy while reducing rework.

Kotak Mahindra Bank | Manager | Sept 2017 – Oct 2022 Role: Business Analyst Project: Digital Account Opening System | Waterfall Project Description: Implemented a digital onboarding platform to automate KYC and streamline account opening. • Conducted Enterprise Analysis, Business Case, Stakeholder Analysis, and prepared the RACI Matrix. • Gathered and documented requirements; prepared BRD, FRD, and supported SRS with technical teams. • Created UML diagrams, wireframes, and process flows using MS Visio, Balsamiq, and Axure. • Maintained RTM, coordinated UAT, and obtained business sign-off for successful implementation. • Managed banking operations, led a team of 12+ associates, and supported client onboarding and KYC compliance.

Project: Domestic Payments Systems Enhancements (NEFT/RTGS/Card Ecosystem) | Waterfall Role: Business Analyst Project Description: Enhanced NEFT, RTGS, and card payment systems to improve transaction processing, STP, and regulatory compliance. • Conducted Enterprise Analysis, Business Case, Stakeholder Analysis, and prepared the RACI Matrix for payment

system enhancements.

• Gathered and documented BRD/FRD for NEFT, RTGS, and card payment workflows; collaborated with technology

teams on solution design.

Analyzed the end-to-end payment lifecycle, including authorization, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, and exception handling.

Created UML diagrams, maintained RTM, and supported UAT, defect analysis, and payment validation. • Supported SWIFT payment message validation, payment operations, and ensured RBI regulatory compliance across transaction processing.

Yes Bank: Role: Senior Analyst |May 2015 – Aug 2017 • Managed transaction banking operations and payment processing. • Performed KYC verification and ensured compliance adherence.

Axis Bank: Role: Analyst|May 2013 – May 2015 • Handled account operations and transaction processing.
